title: Leave unknown metrics unknown instead of inventing confidence
problemCues: Dashboard or summary band missing a value or confidence
preconditions: Metric provenance available or explicitly absent
decision: Render unknown/unavailable states honestly. Do not substitute decorative numbers or false precision. KPI actions that filter details only apply when the metric is real.
exceptions: Explicitly labeled estimates with method disclosed
validatedBy: Fixtures include unknown metric; measure does not require fake values
